name: Outsourced
review:
A quirky 4x4 office game. xWays reveal low or mid symbols in sizes two to four – or a blocker – and xNudge wilds land anywhere, gaining +1 per nudge.

After a win, Print Spins clear the winning symbols to make room for new ones. Extreme volatility, but a fairly low 5,000x cap. Satire in the studio's usual style.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
author: editorial-team
